tasks.gr11-xho-listening-t2: Topic: Interviews, panel discussions, oral summaries, and listening for attitude and bias. Cover interview question types (open and closed), formal register in panel contexts, summarising spoken texts accurately, and identifying attitude, bias, and purpose in oral messages. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to classify question types, recognise formal register features, summarise key points, and identify attitude markers and bias in spoken texts.
tasks.gr11-xho-reading-t2: Topic: Prose study, media texts, visual literacy, social themes, and perspective. Cover social themes in novels and short stories, identifying bias and perspective in media texts, visual design elements (layout, colour, font), and comparing multiple viewpoints with evidence. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify social themes, analyse media perspective, interpret visual design, and justify interpretations with textual evidence.
tasks.gr11-xho-writing-t2: Topic: Review, report, email, speech writing, and transactional control. Cover review structure and evaluative language, report format with headings and objective tone, email and formal letter conventions, and rhetorical devices in speech writing. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to identify transactional format features, choose appropriate language for audience, structure a report correctly, and recognise rhetorical devices.
tasks.gr11-xho-language-t2: Topic: Direct and indirect speech, connectors, passive voice, editing, and cohesion. Cover converting direct speech to indirect speech in isiXhosa, using connectors (cohesive devices) to link ideas, forming and recognising the passive voice, and editing longer texts for cohesion and formal register. Ask Grade 11 FAL learners to convert speech forms, choose appropriate connectors, identify passive voice constructions, and improve cohesion in a given text.
